long_biography.plain_text:
Marc Anthony's earliest singing audience was his family at their kitchen table. His father was a musician who encouraged him to follow the same path. Free local music and arts programmes also helped him develop, before he began writing for other performers and singing backing vocals.

After Zaidy Cárdenas drew attention to an overcrowded boys' home in the Dominican Republic, Anthony visited with her father, concert promoter Henry Cárdenas. The two men established Maestro Cares to improve conditions for disadvantaged children. Its first new home opened in La Romana, and the foundation expanded into housing and education projects elsewhere in Latin America and the United States.
